tools.name: timecamp_get_user
tools.description: Get the TimeCamp user behind the API token: user_id, email, display name, root group and permissions. Good first call to confirm the connection. TimeCamp API: GET /me.

tools.name: timecamp_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (projects and tasks you can track time on), as an object keyed by task id, with parent ids, names and archive state. Filter by task id, external id or status. TimeCamp API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: timecamp_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries between two dates (inclusive), optionally for given users, tasks or tags. Returns the entries the token may see. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/time-entries/list.

tools.name: timecamp_get_timer_status
tools.description: Get the timer of the token's user: whether a timer runs, on which task, and since when. TimeCamp API: GET /v3/timer/status.

tools.name: timecamp_create_time_entry
tools.description: Create a time entry for the token's user on one day. Give start and end time, or a duration in seconds. Adds a new entry on every call. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/time-entries/create.

tools.name: timecamp_update_time_entry
tools.description: Change one time entry by id: date, start and end time, duration, task, note or billable flag. Only the fields you pass change. With increase=true, the duration adds to the current one. TimeCamp API: PUT /v3/time-entries/{id}.

tools.name: timecamp_delete_time_entry
tools.description: Delete one time entry by id. The entry is removed from TimeCamp; this cannot be undone through this tool. TimeCamp API: DELETE /v3/time-entries/{id}.

tools.name: timecamp_start_timer
tools.description: Start a timer for the token's user on a task. The timer records time until it is stopped. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/timer/start.

tools.name: timecamp_stop_timer
tools.description: Stop a running timer and save its time as an entry. Omit timer_id to stop the token user's current timer. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/timer/stop.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: timecamp_get_user, timecamp_list_time_entries · Private data: timecamp_get_user, timecamp_list_time_entries, timecamp_get_timer_status, timecamp_create_time_entry, timecamp_start_timer, timecamp_stop_timer · Public sink: timecamp_get_user, timecamp_list_time_entries, timecamp_create_time_entry, timecamp_start_timer, timecamp_stop_timer · Destructive: timecamp_delete_time_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: timecamp_get_user, timecamp_list_time_entries · Private data: timecamp_get_user, timecamp_list_time_entries, timecamp_get_timer_status, timecamp_create_time_entry, timecamp_start_timer, timecamp_stop_timer · Public sink: timecamp_get_user, timecamp_list_time_entries, timecamp_create_time_entry, timecamp_start_timer, timecamp_stop_timer · Destructive: timecamp_delete_time_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
